key.name: last-page
key.description: The sidebar item selected when the window closed: "home", "all", "authors", "series", "tags", "status:reading", "shelf:ID"…

key.name: library-folder
key.description: The folder books added to Bookcase are copied into, as Author/Title files. Empty means ~/Books.

key.name: view-mode
key.summary: Show books as covers or as a list

key.name: cover-size
key.summary: Width of the covers in the grid, in pixels

key.name: sort-reversed
key.summary: Reverse the order of book lists
key.description: Each sort has its own direction (newest, latest and best first; titles and names A to Z); this turns it round.

key.name: sidebar-hidden
key.summary: Whether the sidebar is hidden in a wide window

key.name: welcome-tip-shown
key.summary: Whether the tip after the first books were added has been seen

key.name: reader-theme
key.description: "auto" follows the system's light or dark style.

key.name: reader-custom-font
key.summary: The font family used when the typeface is "custom"

key.name: reader-margin
key.summary: Side margins, in percent of the page

key.name: reader-max-width
key.summary: Widest a column of text gets, in pixels

key.name: reader-publisher-styles
key.description: When off, Bookcase's typeface, size and spacing override the book's.

key.name: reader-pdf-scrolled
key.summary: Scroll through PDFs instead of turning pages
key.description: PDFs scroll from page to page unless this is off; then they show a page (or two, with reader-two-pages) at a time.

key.name: reader-two-pages
key.summary: Show two pages side by side when the window is wide

key.name: reader-progress-label
key.summary: What the reader's progress label shows

key.name: reader-speech-rate
key.description: Speech Dispatcher's rate: 0 is the voice's normal speed.

key.name: send-kepub
key.summary: Send EPUBs to a Kobo as Kobo EPUBs
key.description: A Kobo shows reading statistics and page numbers only for its own variant of EPUB (.kepub.epub).

key.name: google-books-key
key.description: When set, Find Metadata also asks Google Books. Open Library needs no key.

key.name: goal-books
key.description: The yearly reading goal on the Statistics page; 0 means none.

key.name: goal-minutes
key.description: The daily reading goal on the Statistics page; 0 means none.

key.name: kindle-address
key.description: The Kindle's own e-mail address (name@kindle.com) books are mailed to.

key.name: mail-provider
key.summary: The mail provider Send to Kindle's settings came from

key.name: mail-sender
key.summary: The address books are mailed from
key.description: It must be on the Approved Personal Document E-mail List of the Amazon account.

key.name: mail-security
key.summary: How the connection to the mail server is encrypted

key.name: mail-username
key.description: Empty means the sending address. The password is kept in the keyring.

key.name: kindle-mail-explained
key.summary: Whether Amazon's approved sender list has been explained

key.name: sync-server
key.description: The progress sync server reading positions are kept on: KOReader's public server or one of your own.

key.name: sync-username
key.description: Empty when signed out. The password's key is kept in the keyring.

key.name: sync-document-match
key.summary: How books are matched with other devices
key.description: By the file's content (KOReader's default, “Binary”) or by its file name.

key.name: sync-device-name
key.description: Shown on other devices. Empty: the computer's name.

key.name: sync-device-id
key.description: Made once, at random, so other devices tell this one apart.

key.name: catalogs
key.description: The OPDS catalogues on the Discover page, as JSON: [{"id", "title", "url", "username"}]. Empty means the free catalogues Bookcase comes with. Passwords are kept in the keyring, not here.
